+## #2118 - Review the guide after PR #1995
+
+**Chosen.** Update the existing guide pages for every user-visible PR
+merged after #1995 (through upstream/main `ce59ef446`). The AI Chat pane
+is a section of the MCP page, not a new page.
+
+**Why.** The pane has no network transport yet (#1945 is open), so a page
+of provider setup and worked CAM examples (#1949) would describe controls
+that do not exist. The section states the shipped controls and the limit.
+A new page would also change the navigation test's page list for little
+text.
+
+**Dropped.** #1949 stays open and blocked: provider setup, key storage and
+worked examples wait for #1942, #1944, #1945 and #1947. Library-only
+changes (DXF reader, AC kinematics solver, MCP schema mapper, shape-mask
+verifier) have no user control and need no guide text. Unmerged PRs are not
+documented.
+
+**Cost to change later.** The AI Chat section must be rewritten when the
+transport ships; its "no live transport endpoint" line is pinned by
+`GuideAfter1995` so the test fails with that rewrite.

+## The AI Chat panel
+
+The window has a dock pane for talking to an AI model without leaving the
+app. Open it from **View > Panels > AI Chat**; it opens beside Properties.
+It calls the same MCP tools as an outside agent, so every edit is an
+undoable command with the same checks.
+
+What the pane offers:
+
+- **Provider** and **Model**. The presets are Anthropic (Cloud), OpenAI
+  Responses (Cloud), OpenAI Chat (Cloud), Gemini (Cloud), Offline local
+  (Ollama), Local Prompt-JSON and Local Q&A (Read-Only). A line under the
+  boxes shows the mode and whether the endpoint is Cloud or Local.
+- **Offline only** refuses any cloud preset before anything is sent.
+- **Attach selection** sends your current selection with the prompt. It is
+  off until you tick it. **Attach screenshot** is disabled: the pane says
+  viewport screenshot capture is unavailable.
+- A **Prompt** box with **Send** and **Cancel**. Each tool the model calls
+  shows as a card with its status.
+- **Native tools** mode runs tools directly, but asks first for **post**,
+  **open_project**, **save_project**, **import_model**,
+  **import_tool_library** and **export_tool_library**. **Prompt JSON
+  (confirm every edit)** mode asks before every tool that changes the
+  document. **Read-only Q&A** mode runs no tools and shows a banner. A
+  prompt shows **Confirmation required**, the tool and its arguments, with
+  **Allow** and **Deny**. Deny tells the model the user refused.
+- **Undo Turn** reverts all the changes of one chat turn in one click. It
+  is disabled, and refuses, once you have made a later edit by hand.
+
+Not yet usable: the pane has no network transport in this release. Sending
+to any preset ends with "no live transport endpoint is configured for
+'<preset>'", and an API key setting is not shipped. To use an AI model
+today, connect an outside agent over MCP as described above. These
+worked examples and provider setup will be added when the transport
+ships.
+

+### Open an example project
+
+A release package ships example projects in an `examples` folder beside
+the program. Choose {{ <icon name="file-import" /> }} **Open** in the File
+group, then **Open example**, and pick a project. The list shows the
+`.camproj` files in that folder in name order. If the folder holds none,
+the entry reads **No example projects**. The entry is absent when the
+folder is missing and in the browser build. Opening an example asks first
+if you have unsaved changes, as any project open does.
+
+### What you see after opening a document
+
+Opening a document frames the camera on the opened part and stock, so
+orbiting turns about the part and not about the old view's target. Press F
+to frame again at any time. On a lathe, the viewport lays the spindle axis
+from left to right with the cross-slide up (a mill-turn keeps the milling
+view). This changes only the view,
+not the work offset or the posted program.

+

+take their sizes and colours from the theme, so text and glyphs read
+clearly in both Horizon Day and Teal Night. Browser rows, their eye
+toggles and context-menu rows carry accessibility labels, so a screen

+### A machining mesh is refused or retried
+
+A machining mesh is the surface that gouge checks read. If its measured
+deviation from the model exceeds the requested tolerance, CamCraft retries
+it once at half the chord, keeping every acceptance check, and records the
+finer chord in the mesh report. Deviation on spline and revolved faces is
+measured by orthogonal projection, and the bound covers the surface between
+sample points, not only the sample points. A mesh whose bound still exceeds
+the tolerance is refused by name. Re-export a model with simpler faces, or
+accept a looser tolerance only if the part allows it.
+
 ### `Reduced fidelity: surfaces are approximated to within <tolerance>`

+"""Provenance: Guide coverage for CamCraft changes merged after PR #1995 (#2118)."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import unittest
+
+
+GUIDE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "content/guide"
+
+
+def read_page(path):
+    return " ".join((GUIDE / path).read_text().lower().split())
+
+
+class GuideAfter1995(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_ai_chat_pane_is_described_with_its_limits(self):
+        mcp = read_page("automate/mcp.md")
+        for fact in ("ai chat", "offline only", "undo turn", "allow",
+                     "deny", "no live transport endpoint"):
+            with self.subTest(fact=fact):
+                self.assertIn(fact, mcp)
+
+    def test_open_example_and_view_panels_are_in_first_run(self):
+        first = read_page("getting-started/first-run.md")
+        self.assertIn("open example", first)
+        self.assertIn("no example projects", first)
+        self.assertIn("ai chat", first)
+
+    def test_machine_pages_cover_waterjet_filter_and_c_axis(self):
+        machines = read_page("check-and-post/machines.md")
+        setups = read_page("set-up/setups.md")
+        for fact in ("waterjet", "table plane", "rigid tapping", "-z"):
+            with self.subTest(fact=fact):
+                self.assertIn(fact, machines)
+        self.assertIn("waterjet", setups)
+        self.assertIn("part alignment", setups)
+
+    def test_tools_page_covers_left_hand_taps_and_tool_library_pane(self):
+        tools = read_page("set-up/tools.md")
+        self.assertIn("left-hand tap", tools)
+        self.assertIn("tool information", tools)
+        self.assertIn("tool library", tools)
+
+    def test_contour_slot_and_bore_changes_are_documented(self):
+        ops = read_page("operations/operations-2d.md")
+        refusals = read_page("reference/refusals.md")
+        self.assertIn("side auto on a picked ring", ops)
+        self.assertIn("manual", ops)
+        self.assertIn("spindle stop", ops)
+        self.assertIn("meets its wall at no level", refusals)
+        self.assertIn("tessellation stopped", refusals)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
